children: Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services (IL&FS) has approached the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) seeking recovery of  ₹185.88 crore “excess managerial remuneration” paid to its former directors and those of two group companies following the recasting of financial statements for five financial years, between 2013-14 and 2017-18.

In an application filed before the Mumbai Bench of the NCLT, IL&FS has sought directions to its former directors and two key subsidiaries, IL&FS Financial Services (IFIN) and IL&FS Transportation Networks (ITNL), to return the excess remuneration.

The company has sought an interim direction requiring the identified former directors "to deposit the excess managerial remuneration/undue gains in a separate interest-bearing fixed deposit account", during the pendency of the hearing before NCLT.

Scam-hit IL&FS said it paid remuneration to its erstwhile directors based on profits shown in the original accounts. However, when those accounts were later recast following NCLT directions, they showed losses.

The recast accounts showed that IL&FS actually had a cumulative loss of  ₹9,415.24 crore from FY14 to FY18 against a reported profit of  ₹1,865.73 crore. IFIN’s loss was  ₹5,655.22 crore against a profit of  ₹1,015.67 crore, while ITNL’s loss was  ₹1,628.44 crore against a profit of  ₹1,246.33 crore.
The Ministry of Corporate Affairs had directed it to recover the excess remuneration paid, following which it had issued notices to all 23 erstwhile directors.
However, they have raised objections, said IL&FS, adding that despite multiple notices and reminders, no refund has been made by any of the former managerial personnel.

So far, only three former non-executive directors, two of IL&FS and one of ITNL, have refunded money. Of the  ₹187.02 crore refundable in total, only  ₹91.09 lakh (net of  ₹22.78 lakh paid as income tax) has been refunded so far, “less than 0.5 per cent” of the amount, the application said.
In the application filed before NCLT earlier this week, it has named all 23 former directors as respondents.

The list of former directors named in the recovery proceedings includes several prominent independent directors, such as R C Bhargava, Jaithirth Rao, Michael Pinto, S B Mathur and Rina Kamath of IL&FS; Subhalakshmi Panse, Surinder Singh Kohli and Neera Saggi of IFIN; and Deepak Dasgupta and Pradeep Puri of ITNL.

title: IL&FS moves NCLT to recover ₹185.88 cr from 23 former directors
